content:
sam: Heads up — noticed p95 in latency dashboard spikes only for routes with prefix_filter=true after the prefix-filter rollout. Dashboard shows p95 ~220ms, raw endpoint breakdown shows ~120ms. Anyone seen this?

maya: Can you paste the query you used and a link to the dashboard panel?

sam: ... here's the exact query I ran:
```
SELECT percentile(lat_ms, 95) FROM latency WHERE prefix_filter = true AND endpoint = '/v1/generate'
```

sam: sample log snippet I pulled from the raw endpoint breakdown:
```
endpoint=/v1/generate sample_count=1234 p50=35 p95=220 p99=480
```

eng-bot: deploy: prefix-filtering rollout to prod completed at 2025-03-10T12:08:00Z :rocket:

oliver: this smells like prefiltering happens before our sampling aggregator — if prefilter drops lots of short requests, the sample population changes and percentiles shift.

jess: +1. We should add provenance so console shows whether percentiles are computed on prefilter or postfilter samples. Maybe `prefilter_stage=pre|post` tag in telemetry + console badge.

rahul: aggregator currently merges samples assuming equal weight. We either need to attach inverse-sampling weights or compute TDigest per origin and merge properly. Quick mitigation: expose `sample_origin=raw` vs `sample_origin=post_prefilter` in rollups.

maya: I'm +1 on provenance badges. UX note: avoid forcing users to change their queries — instead show a tooltip on the percentile metric explaining "derived after prefix-filtering: may exclude short requests".

sam: created repro script, will paste gist in a bit. For short-term console fix, a provenance badge would unblock display teams.

oliver: filed GH issue #1382 with telemetry proposal and sample-count fields (presample_count, postfilter_count).

jess: thanks — linking #1382 to rollout PR 987 so infra and console can coordinate.

eng-bot: GH #1382 opened by oliver (https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1382)

sam: pinging @platform-tel for priority — SLO pages for a customer canary are currently showing misleading p95s.

maya: tagging @console-team — can you show a small "percentile derivation" indicator in the panel by EOD?

jess: I'll take the UX patch, need the telemetry flag from tel team.

rahul: I'll put up a short patch to aggregator to carry sample_origin and counts; shouldn't be risky.

sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
